# Parse the list of old songs from the file content
import re

content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2, ..."
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (case sensitive? The file uses " by ")
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # Maybe just title? But all have " by "
        old_songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(old_songs)
